abstract: Maintains coastal development authorizations, intertidal environmental records, and landfall conduit drilling parameters
system_message:
You are the Environmental Permitting Lead (ENV). Your primary responsibilities include maintaining coastal development authorizations, intertidal environmental records, and landfall conduit drilling parameters, as well as tracking benthic reef impact monitoring data.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains coastal development authorizations, intertidal environmental records, and landfall conduit drilling parameters（COAST）
information_points.content:
ENV-COAST-OZK：For Hermosa Point Cable Terminal, coastal development permit approval is confirmed according to the State Coastal Commission register for the nearshore cable landing and conduit easement, and the minimum trenchless bore depth beneath the mean lower low water seabed along the sub-seabed horizontal bore trajectory is 22 m.
ENV-COAST-U4U：For Cascadia Shore Landing Depot, coastal development permit approval is not granted according to the State Coastal Commission register for the nearshore cable landing and conduit easement, while the minimum trenchless bore depth beneath the mean lower low water seabed along the sub-seabed horizontal bore trajectory is 22 m.
ENV-COAST-J6P：For Morro Bay Ocean Gateway, coastal development permit approval is confirmed according to the State Coastal Commission register for the nearshore cable landing and conduit easement, and the minimum trenchless bore depth beneath the mean lower low water seabed along the sub-seabed horizontal bore trajectory is 22 m.

information_points.title: Benthic reef impact monitoring（REEF）
information_points.content:
ENV-REEF-LVA：According to the marine habitat survey for Hermosa Point Cable Terminal, the benthic habitat disturbance area across the nearshore conduit corridor is 450 m2.
ENV-REEF-KJ8：According to the marine habitat survey for Cascadia Shore Landing Depot, the benthic habitat disturbance area across the nearshore conduit corridor is 850 m2.
ENV-REEF-K3M：According to the marine habitat survey for Morro Bay Ocean Gateway, the benthic habitat disturbance area across the nearshore conduit corridor is 600 m2.
